test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

EZU : GCY :: NHB : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : In each letter's position value consecutive number are added i.e (+2), (+3) and (+4) respectively in this serial order.

So, 

 
• EZU : GCY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd27caaa06f75cb308df5d2ebb5646d395eed3950561b683dd887088b50d55c4.png] 

Similarly,

 
• NHB is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/396facc0189684efdb1a7c8b1ebe12103c03b7d3e7000d1c14d2187ea3249326.png] ​

Hence, **"PKF"** is the correct answer.

8b
